digest.component_or_area: rebar tracker-footprint command and measurement library
propositions: Add an explicit opt-in read-only rebar tracker-footprint command that measures git pack bytes, checkout logical bytes, checkout allocated bytes, and whole-clone totals without implicit execution from ticket writes or CI gates

Implement a reusable measurement module that separates packed object bytes, checkout logical bytes, checkout allocated bytes with st_blocks support, file count, and git-directory logical bytes in both mounted and fresh-clone modes

Fresh-clone mode resolves the configured tickets remote, creates a temporary unfiltered single-branch clone with hardlink optimization disabled, measures it completely, then removes only the command-owned temporary directory
The measurement never enforces thresholds, shrink-only ratchets, baseline mutations, or exit-code failures based solely on size; size is descriptive and observational only

JSON and text output report measured ref, tip, and layered definitions (packed, logical checkout, allocated checkout, git-directory, whole-clone) with structured unavailable values for platforms lacking st_blocks
Linked-worktree default mode labels shared object databases as shared rather than standalone to avoid misrepresenting object bytes as standalone-clone cost
